name: fxpack
title: FXPACK: phaser, flanger, fold, fuzz, DJ filter, transient shaper, texture
summary: One FX-list row FX MIX with seven small effects (pick with the blue knob on page 1): PHASER (4-8 allpass stages), FLANGER (+/- feedback), FOLD (triangle/sine wavefolder), FUZZ (5 curves + gate), DJ FILTER (one knob LP/off/HP, 12/24 dB, wobble), TRANSIENT (attack/sustain shaper) and TEXTURE (vinyl, tape, rain, wind, radio, room bed with breath and duck). Page 1: TYPE + the effect's first three knobs; page 2 (knob push): MIX + three more. Synth, drum and master FX (master: per channel, LFO spread). Hosted on phone with an in-range marker in fx_params 5-8: presets pass TE's checks and load on stock firmware as phone.

sql: INSERT INTO fx_types (id, type, default_params) SELECT MAX(id) + 1, 'fx mix', '[7300, 13107, 7680, 32767, 25161, 28671, 27852, 28671]' FROM fx_types

controls: FX list: FX MIX (one row); page 1 blue picks PHASER FLANGER FOLD FUZZ DJ FILTER TRANSIENT TEXTURE
synth FX screen, FXPACK: knob push flips page 1 (blue: TYPE, one effect per click; green/white/orange: the effect's first three values) / page 2 (blue: MIX; green/white/orange: the page-2 values)
mixer FX page (master FX = FX MIX, on): same pages, knob push = page 2
